ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota ICE facility controversy
ideas.description: This story would investigate the controversy surrounding the Minnesota ICE facility, including the shooting of Renee Good and the subsequent cover-up allegations.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential corruption
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Renee Good?
Is there evidence of a cover-up by the Trump administration?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a large-scale conspiracy and corruption at the highest levels of government. I would approach this story by following the money and investigating potential corruption.
